schemes.name: comp16_diagonal_court

ops.why: Use the existing four-storey court as a control of a continuous perimeter and useful occupied depth.
Grade the perimeter toward one diagonal so the section changes across the court; stop before the shallow edge loses occupied depth.

schemes.secondary_language: A diagonal top plane unifies the occupied court perimeter while leaving the centre open.
schemes.formal_principle: A diagonal top plane unifies the occupied court perimeter while leaving the centre open.
schemes.reference_basis: Explicit replay/adaptation of archived j_sail_over_court visible in the user-supplied study atlas; not a claim of new vocabulary.

schemes.name: comp16_folded_section

ops.why: Retain the existing three-storey body as the occupied budget for the folds.
Split the long body into unequal bars so the folds have legible runs; an undrawn doorway or connection is not assumed.
Use three folds of the existing controlled pitch; actual roof sections must survive delivery.

schemes.secondary_language: Two unequal occupied bars share a repeated folded section, so the roofs and long body are read together.
schemes.formal_principle: Two unequal occupied bars share a repeated folded section, so the roofs and long body are read together.
schemes.reference_basis: Explicit replay/adaptation of archived folded_plate_bar visible in the user-supplied study atlas; not a claim of new vocabulary.

schemes.name: comp16_inclined_canyon

ops.why: Keep the existing four-storey occupied depth as a current-engine control.
Separate two unequal bodies along the long axis; preserve the authored gap as a spatial proposition, not proof of a public access route.
Grade toward the open side and check the actual roof slope after fitting; the occupied body must not become a thin decorative wedge.

schemes.secondary_language: Two inclined occupied bodies define an open lane, with roof directions reinforcing the approach.
schemes.formal_principle: Two inclined occupied bodies define an open lane, with roof directions reinforcing the approach.
schemes.reference_basis: Explicit replay/adaptation of archived canyon_twin_wedges visible in the user-supplied study atlas; not a claim of new vocabulary.

schemes.name: comp16_turning_hexagon

ops.why: Reauthor the archived thirteen-storey proposition at five occupied storeys; the reduced stature is explicit, not an exemption from the current site gate.
Turn the section through seventy-five degrees so a helical edge is visible; a core, transfer structure and usable floor perimeter remain unresolved.

schemes.secondary_language: A five-storey hexagonal body turns through its section, with repeated changing edges instead of a flat prismatic silhouette.
schemes.formal_principle: A five-storey hexagonal body turns through its section, with repeated changing edges instead of a flat prismatic silhouette.
schemes.reference_basis: Explicit replay/adaptation of archived bt_rotating_stack visible in the user-supplied study atlas; not a claim of new vocabulary.

schemes.name: comp16_bent_body

ops.why: Reauthor the archived seven-storey body at four storeys and retain its continuous occupied form.
Bend through forty-two degrees in six existing segments; check actual overlaps and depth rather than treating the segment count as architectural quality.

schemes.secondary_language: One occupied bar bends into a concave figure and frames an exterior room without becoming a box cluster.
schemes.formal_principle: One occupied bar bends into a concave figure and frames an exterior room without becoming a box cluster.
schemes.reference_basis: Explicit replay/adaptation of archived bt_bent_bar visible in the user-supplied study atlas; not a claim of new vocabulary.

schemes.name: comp16_waisted_court

ops.why: Reauthor the archived seven-storey court at four storeys; preserve an actual open void and occupied perimeter.
Pinch the body in plan to differentiate the two ends while retaining material connectivity; do not infer routes through solid contact.

schemes.secondary_language: Compress the court perimeter into a waisted figure so enclosure varies along its length.
schemes.formal_principle: Compress the court perimeter into a waisted figure so enclosure varies along its length.
schemes.reference_basis: Explicit replay/adaptation of archived bt_pressed_ring visible in the user-supplied study atlas; not a claim of new vocabulary.

author: Codex comp16 geometric breadth: three preserved geometric controls and three explicit stature adaptations
assumptions: Whole-repertoire family supply is required; round-only is not used for this production comparison.
The archived high-rise versions remain preserved; new four/five-storey adaptations are separate authored choices.
Programme, accessible circulation, parking strategy and engineered structure remain unverified. No universal FAR target is imposed.
